items.title: Can AI spot breast cancer earlier? NHS launches world's largest trial to find out
items.summary: Researchers will test the technology in breast cancer screening which could ease pressure on the NHS.

items.title: Rapper releases statement after 'unknown substance' sparks concert evacuation
items.summary: Rapper Don Toliver has postponed his O2 Arena gig this evening after an "unknown substance" sparked a mass evacuation at his concert in Manchester.

items.title: Pip assessments need 'fundamental overhaul', report to say
items.summary: Disability Minister Sir Stephen Timms says he will recommend major reforms to the personal independence payment.

items.title: Hacker sentenced for leaking Grand Theft Auto VI clips

items.title: US rapper postpones O2 arena show after Manchester evacuation

items.title: Snow forecast as cold health alerts in parts of UK
